---
applyTo: "**/*.cs,src/clutch-web/src/**,**/appsettings*.json,**/*.config"
---
# SEC-001 / SEC-002 / SEC-003 Security

Never commit secrets. Never log credentials, tokens or sensitive data. Validate untrusted input on the server. Load the `clutch-security-review` skill for endpoint, auth, input, secrets or sensitive-data changes, and for the independent review.
